Players Committee card image of [[Mace Windu (V)]] (original printing), game text: “During battle, Mace may 'swing' one lightsaber twice. Fetts may not add battle destiny draws here. Immune to attrition <6 (<8 if with a Dark Jedi).”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1-Light/large/macewindu.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.
